messages:
Maria (Sales): FYI — FinRegCo wants to run a 3-month POC with strict EU residency + APAC read-only fallback. They specifically asked for: list of subprocessors per region, KMS options (customer-managed?), and cost delta for residency routing. Can @Tom (Eng) @Anish (Security) @Olga (Legal) weigh in?

Tom (Eng): Quick clarifying q: do they require in-country (e.g., DE-only) or is region-level (EU) sufficient for the POC? Implementation will differ.

Maria (Sales): They said "EU-only for production", for the POC they're ok with EU-region pinning, but want to know how failover to APAC (read-only analytics) would look and whether any subprocessor crosses borders.

Anish (Security): Short answer: we can provide a per-region subprocessor inventory and cert matrix. If customer needs CMK (customer-managed keys) we can integrate for Private/Dedicated; hosted has KMS add-on with HSM-backed keys. Send me the security questionnaire items and I’ll prefill. :white_check_mark:

Olga (Legal): Contract note: for cross-border subprocessors we need to flag data transfer clauses and add the standard SCCs. For a POC we can do a short-term addendum; need expected data retention & deletion timeline from the customer. Also, confirm whether they require subprocessor NDA escalation.

Kelly (Product): Ops/config note — here's a sample routing policy we can propose to the customer for the POC (keeps the behavior explicit):

```json
{
  "routing_mode": "geo-affinity",
  "primary_region": "eu-west-1",
  "region_pin": true,
  "fallback_sequence": ["eu-central-1", "apac-southeast-1"],
  "kms_mode": "customer-managed-optional",
  "logging": "redwood-audit:enabled"
}
```

Kelly (Product): Important: with geo-affinity and region_pin=true we keep KV caches and prefix caching per-region which increases per-token memory, so perf and cost delta need a quick estimate.

Tom (Eng): Implementation constraints: Dedicated -> we can pin tenants to EU datacenter (no cross-border subprocessors). Hosted -> we can do routing with geo-affinity but some control-plane subprocessors (monitoring/analytics) may be US-based unless we isolate. I'll do a short LOE and perf/cost delta for 5 req/s steady and 50k tokens/day.

Tom (Eng): Also flag: KMS failover behavior — if customer-managed KMS in eu-west fails, current fallback is to fail closed by default unless we pre-authorize a secondary CMK in eu-central. That requires key replication/consent and ~2-3 days ops work.

Maria (Sales): Pricing ask: what's the incremental cost for the residency controls + KMS add-on for a 3-month POC at roughly 5 req/s? Need a ballpark to quote to the customer tomorrow.

Tom (Eng): Ballpark: Hosted with residency routing + KMS add-on ~ +20% on hosted unit cost due to egress/replication + KMS per-month add-on (~$Xxxx). Dedicated reserved pool (small) looks like ~$4k-6k/mo depending on commit and GPU type. I'll send a more precise estimate in the next 6 hours.

ops-bot: new doc added -> https://internal.redwood/sales/poc-playbooks/residency-quickstart (automated upload)

Anish (Security): For the security questionnaire: I'll prefill these items today — subprocessor list (by region), certs (SOC2/ISO), KMS options & failover behavior, and the minimal network topology diagram. @Maria (Sales) please attach the customer's data flow diagram if you have it.

Olga (Legal): I'll draft a 3-month POC addendum template that covers residency commitments, subprocessor disclosure, and deletion timeframe. Need customer contact for signature.

Maria (Sales): Great. Action items and owners:
- Tom (Eng): perf + cost estimate (5 req/s, 50k tokens/day) — due today EOD.
- Anish (Security): prefill SecurityQ + subproc certs — due today midday.
- Olga (Legal): POC addendum draft — due tomorrow morning.
- Kelly (Product): routing snippet & suggested telemetry fields to include for the POC — update this thread with suggested metrics.

Maria (Sales): I'll consolidate and send a single response to FinRegCo by EOD with the proposed config and rough costs. Thanks all! :pray:
